displayName: OCI-AI-PD-008: AI — Prompt Injection via Tool/Function Calling
description:
Detects prompt injection through malicious tool or function call definitions

conditions.value: ai — prompt injection via tool/function calling

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_008", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%injection%') AND "value" > 0
